verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a SaaS remote-desktop product with a REST API and CLI, so a sandbox or test account for API work is a fair thing for a buyer to ask about. The evidence pack documents only production account management, session automation and an open-source Python module. Nothing shows a sandbox, test environment, or dry-run mode isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
